resources.string: Open Google Wallet from the diagnosed ColorOS double-power shortcut.
Google Wallet is installed and can be opened.
Google Wallet is missing or disabled. Install or enable Google Wallet, then try again.
Android could not open Google Wallet. Check that it is enabled and try again.
Unlock your phone to open Google Wallet.
Unlock was cancelled or unavailable. Unlock your phone and retry.

Select Wallet for the double-press power shortcut in ColorOS settings. This bridge receives the FinShell OPEN intent; it does not monitor power presses itself.

No accessibility service, background service, network access or secure-settings permission is needed. Your normal device unlock is required.

A factory FinShell package with a different signing certificate can prevent installation, even if disabled or removed for your user. See the repository installation guide. This build has not yet been validated on your phone.
